title: GPU Software — eBPF
description: What each pod asks CUDA to do, and where it waits — entirely eBPF-sourced (kernel launches, memory operations, synchronization, HAMi interception). Complements GPU Hardware: this dashboard never says what the silicon did, only what the workload asked it to do. Rows follow the metric catalog's groups (Overview → Compute Activity → Memory Activity → Errors → HAMi Enforcement → Synchronization Latency → Kernel Launch Dimensions). Panels are built for every eBPF metric family, including those no workload here has exercised yet; each such panel says so rather than rendering an unexplained blank.

panels.title: Total CUDA Kernel Launches
panels.description: Total kernels launched by the selected pods and GPUs across the current time window. The single clearest liveness signal this dashboard has

targets.expr: sum(increase(ebpf_cuda_kernel_launch_calls_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Total CUDA Errors
panels.description: Total failed CUDA driver calls (non-zero return code) in the window, across every probed function. Not yet observed on this cluster

targets.expr: sum(increase(ebpf_cuda_errors_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Total HAMi OOM Events
panels.description: Total allocations HAMi's interception library refused because a pod exceeded its memory quota. Not yet observed on this cluster: no traced workload has hit a HAMi memory limit, consistent with the compute-throttle signal (Errors row) also never firing here. A strong signal to raise the memory quota the moment it appears.

targets.expr: sum(increase(ebpf_hami_oom_events_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))

panels.title: CUDA Kernel Launch Rate
panels.description: Kernels submitted to the GPU per second, per pod

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_kernel_launch_calls_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CUDA Graph Launch Rate
panels.description: How often the workload replays a captured CUDA Graph (cuGraphLaunch)

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_graph_launch_calls_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Host-Side CUDA Kernel Launch Latency Distribution
panels.description: Full distribution of how long the HOST waited inside the launch call, across the selected pods. A P95/P99 line (right) can hide a bimodal stall

targets.expr: sum by (le) (rate(ebpf_cuda_kernel_launch_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Host-Side CUDA Kernel Launch Latency P95/P99
panels.description: How long the HOST waited to submit work, not GPU runtime

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, le) (rate(ebpf_cuda_kernel_launch_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, le) (rate(ebpf_cuda_kernel_launch_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Pods Ranked by CUDA Activity
panels.description: Every pod that launched at least one CUDA kernel in the selected window, ranked by launch count

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_owner_name, gpu_uuid) (increase(ebpf_cuda_kernel_launch_calls_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__range]))

panels.title: GPU Memory Allocation Rate
panels.description: Bytes/second successfully allocated on the GPU (device, managed, pinned-host and stream-ordered allocators). Not yet observed on this cluster. PyTorch's caching allocator takes a few large allocations at warm-up and then reuses that arena, so steady-state training produces almost no cudaMalloc calls. Once populated, steady growth without matching frees (right) indicates a memory leak.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_allocations_bytes_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: GPU Memory Allocation Call Rate
panels.description: Allocation calls per second, independent of size. Not yet observed on this cluster, for the same caching-allocator reason as the byte rate to the left. Once populated, many small calls in a row (high call rate, low average size) indicates fragmentation risk rather than a caching allocator reusing its pool.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_allocations_calls_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average Memory Allocation Size
panels.description: Bytes per allocation call, averaged over the rate window. Not yet observed on this cluster

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_allocations_bytes_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_allocations_calls_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

panels.title: GPU Memory Free Rate
panels.description: Bytes/second of GPU memory freed, including host-pinned unregister. Not yet observed on this cluster

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_frees_bytes_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: GPU Memory Free Call Rate
panels.description: Free calls per second. Not yet observed on this cluster, same reason as Free Rate above. Once populated, pair with Allocation Call Rate: a large persistent imbalance indicates a leak or over-eager release.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_frees_calls_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memory Copy Traffic by Direction
panels.description: Data movement per second, split by direction (cuda_memcpy_kind). Host-to-device bytes are usually the input pipeline; sustained high copy with low kernel activity in Compute Activity means the GPU is being starved. Device-to-device dominates during NCCL all-reduce in multi-GPU training.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, gpu_uuid, cuda_memcpy_kind) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_copies_bytes_total_sum{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu",cuda_memcpy_kind=~"MemcpyHostToDevice"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, gpu_uuid, cuda_memcpy_kind) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_copies_bytes_total_sum{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu",cuda_memcpy_kind=~"MemcpyDeviceToHost"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, gpu_uuid, cuda_memcpy_kind) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_copies_bytes_total_sum{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu",cuda_memcpy_kind=~"MemcpyDeviceToDevice"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memset Traffic — Sync vs Async
panels.description: Bytes/second cleared on the device (cudaMemset / cudaMemsetAsync), split by whether the call blocks the host. High sync-memset rates are often wasteful buffer re-initialisation that could be replaced with the async form or with reuse.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_memset_bytes_total_sum{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu",cuda_memset_async="false"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_memset_bytes_total_sum{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu",cuda_memset_async="true"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: P2P Peer Copy Traffic
panels.description: Direct GPU-to-GPU transfer bytes/second over NVLink/PCIe, bypassing the host. Not yet observed on this cluster: every validated workload (gpu-burn, resnet50/shufflenet_v2) ran on a single shared card, so there was no peer traffic to trace. Non-zero once populated only for workloads that copy directly between devices

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, gpu_uuid) (rate(ebpf_cuda_memory_peer_copies_bytes_total_sum{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CUDA Errors per Interval
panels.description: New CUDA errors per interval, broken down by which function failed and its return code (e.g. 2 = out of memory, 1 = invalid argument, 400 = invalid handle). Not yet observed on this cluster

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, cuda_function, cuda_error_code) (increase(ebpf_cuda_errors_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: HAMi OOM Events per Interval
panels.description: New HAMi quota-denied allocations per interval, by function and memory kind. Not yet observed on this cluster

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, cuda_function, hami_oom_mem_kind, hami_oom_error_code) (increase(ebpf_hami_oom_events_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: HAMi Compute Throttle Latency P95/P99
panels.description: How long HAMi's rate limiter delayed each kernel launch before passing it to the driver

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, le) (rate(ebpf_hami_compute_throttle_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, le) (rate(ebpf_hami_compute_throttle_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: HAMi OOM Events — Detail Table
panels.description: All HAMi OOM tuples in the selected time range, even for pods that have already exited

targets.expr: max_over_time(sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, cuda_function, hami_oom_mem_kind, hami_oom_error_code) (ebpf_hami_oom_events_total{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"})[$__range:])

panels.title: CUDA Stream Sync Latency P95/P99

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, le) (rate(ebpf_cuda_stream_sync_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Kernel Grid Size P95/P99
panels.description: Distribution of grid size (gridX × gridY × gridZ = total thread blocks) requested per kernel launch. P95/P99 reveal the largest kernels being scheduled

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, le) (rate(ebpf_cuda_kernel_grid_size_total_bucket{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Distribution of block size (blockX × blockY × blockZ = threads per block) requested per kernel launch. With Grid Size, this explains an SM occupancy figure on the GPU Hardware dashboard

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_pod_uid, gpu_uuid, le) (rate(ebpf_cuda_kernel_block_size_total_bucket{k8s_pod_name=~"$pod",gpu_uuid=~"$gpu"}[$__rate_interval])))
